'''Clone gunners''' or '''clone tank gunners''' were specialized [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] as [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]] on several of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] vehicles, [[Warship/Legends|warships]], and heavy [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] cannons.

==Overview==
[[File:Clone_Gunner.png|thumb|left|250px|Clone tank gunner operating an [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon]].]]
While all [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were trained to fire larger weapon platforms such as artillery and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]], there were some who were selected for specialized training in this field. These individuals were trained to become experts in such an art and engaged enemies long before they could reach close range combat. One of the hardest lessons for such recruits to forget was the fact that sustained fire gave away their position. While a useful trait amongst clone troopers on the battlefield, clone gunners had to forget such an aspect in combat in order to work effectively.<ref name="SW:TCWCE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

In terms of equipment, they were often provided with [[DC-15s side arm blaster|DC-15s]] [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] for close range combat though they were typically seen using heavy weapon emplacements. These troopers wore custom [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone armor]] that had [[Color/Legends|grey]] and tan on the helmet and a little extra armor on the chest plate. The helmet was insulated from noise and in addition their armor was reinforced to better protect themselves from the recoil of the cannons that they manned.<ref name="SW:TCWCE" /> In terms of artillery, these soldiers were often seen operating [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|AV-7 Antivehicle Cannons]], the [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|cannon]] of [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TEs]], and the heavy [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]] of [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|Juggernaut tanks]]. 

==History==
These clones were born and bred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] which was considered their ''"homeworld"'' and swore their allegiance to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="SW:TCWCE" /> Clone gunners served in many campaigns for the Republic such as the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]],<ref name="TCw">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]],<ref name="DoD">{{TCW|Downfall of a Droid}}</ref> the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]],<ref name="SoR">{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref> the [[First Battle of Felucia/Legends|First Battle of Felucia]],<ref name="Holocron Heist">{{TCW|Holocron Heist}}</ref> the [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|Battle of Devaron]],<ref name="CoD">{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}}</ref> the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]]<ref name="LaPR">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref>, and the [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|Battle of Saleucami]], among others.<ref name="Deserter">{{TCW|The Deserter}}</ref>
